CAPTAIN-HOOK REVIEW VERDICT: diff itself clean (consistent field/initializer/agent-literal removal; the renamed test genuinely regression-guards via rendered plists; 12.20.11 numbering correct) — but one MAJOR, CONFIRMED one repo down: daemonkit's ApplyInstalledCandidate reconciliation switch (deployment/apply.go:99-118) has no applyRolledBack case, so a machine whose prior apply rolled back (exactly what a bootstrap-EIO Converge failure produces — the local machine's receipt after three failed reinstalls) hits ErrInstallConflict "pending apply differs from request" (apply.go:221-223) on the next differing-fingerprint apply instead of self-healing. The 12.20.11 CHANGELOG's "first upgrade onto this build re-registers both agents" claim is false for precisely the wedged population motivating the fix.

DECISION: fix it in v0.20.7 (third item, same fable lane/worktree: applyRolledBack + differing fingerprint → retire and restage, same-fingerprint retry unchanged, table test) rather than softening the changelog — without it the wave cannot deliver itself to wedged machines. CONSEQUENCE: captain-hook 12.20.11 must repin daemonkit v0.20.7 (its own postinstall needs the fixed state machine) — reversing the earlier keep-v0.20.6 call; deploymentDaemonkitLine goes to 0.20.7 in the release commit. Handshake-safe per the WireBuild analysis (product-schema identity, not module version). Review scoreboard: cc-notes CLEAN, synckit blocker→correction in flight, captain-hook clean-with-daemonkit-gap (being fixed), fusekit + daemonkit verdicts pending.
